stem: One product sample from an affected rack has an extreme measurement while neighboring representative samples do not. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: The single extreme sample automatically defines the entire lot
Verify the measurement and evaluate representative sampling, location, genealogy, and process evidence before defining lot-wide scope
Ignore the extreme result because most samples differ
Technician II should make the final disposition immediately
rationale: A dramatic single result requires verification and representative context. Technician II supports evidence gathering and scope definition; final disposition remains with authorized QA/management.
